kubernetes.description: Only the plain Job/CronJob and CR-image files; scanning every yaml would double-count the HelmReleases

customManagers.description: CNPG Cluster image is read from imageName, not an image: key; the floating tag 17 is pinned in a follow-up
Dragonfly operator manifest is applied from a versioned raw URL; the kustomize manager only reads github.com ?ref= URLs
barman-cloud plugin manifest is applied from a versioned GitHub release URL

packageRules.description: Keep chart and image bumps in one PR, otherwise the chart rolls without its matching image tags
Digest pins for the ~130 tag-only images would otherwise open one PR each (no PR limits are set)

commitlint caps the header at 100 chars; the untouched 70-char depName pushes 'chore(deps): update <depName> docker tag to vX.Y.Z' to 112 and makes every bump of this image unmergeable. Only the display name changes.
A CNPG major needs a planned pg_upgrade or import, and a Ceph major goes with a Rook upgrade plan; never open these as tag bumps
Kavita stable tags have 3 parts (0.9.1) and 4 parts (0.9.0.2); semver drops the 4-part ones
docker.getoutline.com does not answer Renovate lookups; outlinewiki/outline on Docker Hub has the same tags and the same digest. The deployed reference stays on docker.getoutline.com
Stateful databases, storage and their operators: an automerged patch restarted the Galera cluster unannounced (2026-10-11), so these update only through a reviewed PR

bumpVersions.description: Flux keys the HelmChart artifact by the chart version, so an image-tag bump in an in-repo chart's values.yaml is never rendered onto the cluster unless Chart.yaml moves with it -- and nothing reports an error when it does not
bumpVersions.name: in-repo helm chart version
